notes.title: Achievements and more
notes.content:
[list]
[*] This is the first build after I completed DoD2, with all changes for Episode 2
[*] Mostly this means you can now play with Keyboard Standalone (no mouse required) and
[*] Gamepad UI / controls are significantly improved
[*] Also I made Dark Waters less error-prone
[*] And finally: Achievements :D
[/list]

notes.title: 1.14 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Localization for 16 Languages
- Fixed potential lock in level 79
- Fixed tree can’t be pushed down stairs in “You shall not pass”
- Fixed PlayerChar was invisible after loading a dream level
- Fixed Cheat Unlock (some numbers were off)
- Fixed throw stone and restart to glitch a second stone
- Made empty bottle sprite more obviously empty

notes.title: 1.12 Patch Notes
notes.content: - fixed critical bug that spawned units and stuff from other levels

notes.title: 1.11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fixes:
-- Fixed volume: Narrator and leveltransition sound ignored volume slider
-- Fix bug: for anyone who still somehow manages to miss ivars book it is now put as fallback in levels 84 (earliest possible) and 98 (latest possible to fix any already corrupted savegame)
-- Fixed bug: that would let you (in rare cases) throw your sword on ending a dialogue
-- Removed legacy dev feature: delete all playerprefs on pressing R lol
- Polish:
-- Level 82 ‘death trap’: 
--- removed 2 gobs for more agenda clarity
--- no going back upstairs once ivar has followed
-- level 95 'fortress': 
--- removed teleport to prevent telefragging the minos (to force the player to unleash the dragon)
-- no going back upstairs once dragon has followed

notes.title: 1.10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Fixed ui item button order (for easier gamepad use)
[*]Added volume slider
[*]Decreased level transition music volume
[*]Nerfed language in Dream 3
[*]Allowing to trigger Hints via Gamepad
[/olist]

notes.title: 1.09 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixes in 1.09:
- throwing stuff when exiting a level no longer possible
- gamepad button "restart" no longer works in cutscenes
- in level 50 when stone is thrown at zombie prevent going back up (which results in dead end)
- for convenience, changed savegame location (from registry to file in appdata)

notes.title: Potential fix and parachute patch for lost savegames
notes.content:
Patch: 
- Probably fixed issue that could kill savegames on crash
- Parachute Patch: Added a Cheat-Unlock option in savegames in case this still happens for someone.
